job.text: Make the finance director aware of which departments ran over budget in January

insight.important: Marketing and Operations ran furthest over budget; IT and Finance stayed under

title.text: Marketing and Operations Ran Furthest over Budget
title.descriptive: Deviation from Budget by Department, January 2020

measure.name: expenses as a share of budget

source.shows: red and green for bad and good (G4.16, G8.14): bars over budget bad, under budget good, the extreme labels saying which side is which in its colour; semantic colours for every reader, plain, in one file (D-18)

reasons.chart.value_labels: the book's deviation chart keeps its scale, whose extreme labels name the sides (s. 0375, G8.14)

source.shows: the same chart where black-and-white reproduction is likely (audience.bw_risk): red and green told apart without colour too, which serves readers with colour-vision deficiency as well, a hatch of two tones of the red over each bad bar and a dither of two tones of the green over each good one, each blending to its colour at reading distance; one file (D-18). The colour-blind-safe pair, orange and blue with a red/green copy, is a style's option for publications to unknown readers, not a chart's
